findings.evidence: original.history_weight = round(original.history_weight - assignment.weight, 4) — no floor protection
findings.trigger: Double withdrawal or ledger-bug path can produce negative history_weight
findings.impact: Fairness ledger can contain negative history_weight values, undermining the fairness guarantee
findings.root_cause: history_duties is floored at max(0, ...) but history_weight is not
findings.regression_risk: Low — existing tests for withdrawal may need a negative-weight boundary case

findings.trigger: Double-compensated ledger entry during roster withdrawal
findings.impact: history_duties can go negative, corrupting fairness history
findings.root_cause: Same pattern as FINDING-1 — apply_leave_adjustment uses max(0, ...) but withdrawal does not

findings.evidence: except Exception: raise — first failure aborts all remaining backup obligation repairs
findings.trigger: One corrupt backup obligation entry blocks all subsequent repairs
findings.impact: A single corrupted backup record can permanently block the entire backup repair pipeline
findings.root_cause: Bare re-raise without collecting failures; loop breaks on first exception
findings.recommendation: Collect failures in a list, attempt all obligations, raise aggregate at end
findings.regression_risk: Medium — test needs multi-backup failure scenario

findings.evidence: from nicegui_app.services.workflow_dependencies import * — wildcard import dumps 50+ symbols into 8 module namespaces
findings.trigger: Any change to workflow_dependencies.py or workflow_types.py silently affects all mixins
findings.impact: Import pollution obscures ownership; adding a new symbol to dependencies silently changes 8 modules
findings.root_cause: workflow_dependencies.py uses __all__ = [name for name in globals() if not name.startswith('_')]
findings.recommendation: Replace import * with explicit imports; define __all__ as a fixed list
findings.regression_risk: Medium — requires verifying all 8 modules still resolve their needed symbols

findings.evidence: RosterWeekRecord.week_start == week_start - timedelta(days=7) — assumes exactly 7-day intervals
findings.trigger: Non-consecutive weeks (school breaks, summer) produce None for previous week lookup
findings.impact: Flexible-weekly mode has no rotation history, potentially assigning same person to same weekday across a gap
findings.root_cause: Hardcoded 7-day offset instead of selecting max(week_start) where week_start < current
findings.recommendation: Use SELECT ... WHERE week_start < :current ORDER BY week_start DESC LIMIT 1
findings.regression_risk: Medium — behavior change in assist mode across non-consecutive weeks

findings.evidence: Identical 11-line function duplicated in guest_adapter.py:73-81 and lifecycle.py:11-21
findings.trigger: Assist mode code normalization changes must be synchronized in two places
findings.impact: Future changes may be applied to only one copy, creating divergent behavior for Guest vs Admin
findings.root_cause: No shared location for the code-to-enum normalization
findings.recommendation: Move to workflow_dependencies.py or workflow_types.py; import from single source

findings.evidence: Pure multiple-inheritance shell with no interface contract. New mixin methods silently become uncallable if not threaded through the class
findings.trigger: Adding a new method to a mixin without declaring it in RosterWorkflow
findings.impact: Method resolution may silently fail at runtime; no static guarantee that all mixin methods are accessible
findings.root_cause: No ABC, no abstract methods, no interface validation
findings.recommendation: Define AbstractRosterWorkflow with @abstractmethod stubs; validate at import

findings.evidence: CSP includes script-src 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' — CSP provides zero XSS defense-in-depth
findings.trigger: Any XSS vector that evades output escaping will execute unimpeded
findings.impact: All XSS defense rests entirely on the correctness of attr() and text() usage in html_safety.py
findings.root_cause: NiceGUI 3.13 requires unsafe-inline (Vue bootstrap) and unsafe-eval (template compiler)
findings.recommendation: Document exact CSP compatibility at each ui.html(sanitize=False) and ui.run_javascript() call site. Add regression test for new unsafe usage.
findings.regression_risk: None — this is a framework constraint, not an application bug

findings.evidence: console.warn outputs structured JSON for every failed admin login — reason field reveals validation step
findings.trigger: Repeated auth failures from same IP produce log entries showing which check failed (jwt_missing, jwt_email_allowlist, etc.)
findings.impact: Attacker can probe which auth steps pass/fail by observing log patterns in Cloudflare dashboard
findings.root_cause: Production-grade auth failure logging that includes internal failure reasons
findings.recommendation: Use debug-level logging or cap rate of identical log entries. Consider generic 'auth_failed' message.

findings.evidence: Chinese text hardcoded in JavaScript string — not in i18n catalog. English also hardcoded at line 341.
findings.trigger: Auth-exit state HTML cannot be locale-switched at runtime
findings.impact: Bilingual parity violation; auth error UI shows fixed language regardless of user preference
findings.root_cause: JavaScript injected via ui.run_javascript() has no access to i18n catalog
findings.recommendation: Move auth-exit HTML to a Python helper that reads from i18n catalog before injection
findings.regression_risk: Medium — requires moving JS injection to a Python-level template

findings.evidence: except Exception as error: self.backup_repair_error = type(error).__name__ — only exception type saved, no message
findings.impact: Operator sees 'backupRepairFailed: true' with no diagnostic detail; debugging requires server log access
findings.root_cause: Deliberately conservative: store only type to avoid leaking paths/values. But message is also safe.
findings.recommendation: Store f'{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}' — type name alone is insufficient

findings.evidence: When receipt exists (idempotent replay), session.rollback() is called without verifying backup obligation was fulfilled
findings.trigger: Original backup write crashed after commit but before backup was written
findings.impact: Returned backup_path may be None; pending obligation silently unfulfilled
findings.root_cause: Idempotent replay assumes completed backup equals fulfilled obligation
findings.recommendation: Check backup_obligation table after replay; if unfulfilled, attempt fulfillment

findings.trigger: Future change to form rank format would need updating in two places
findings.impact: Maintenance hazard — two implementations may diverge
findings.root_cause: No shared utility for form rank parsing
findings.recommendation: Export from roster_policy and import from single source

findings.evidence: DUTY_TIME_WINDOWS = ROOM_OPENING_TIME_WINDOWS — deprecated alias used only in tests, not production
findings.impact: Confusion about which constant to use for new code
findings.recommendation: Remove the alias; update test references to use ROOM_OPENING_TIME_WINDOWS directly

findings.evidence: No Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy header on origin middleware. Worker adds it at edge.
findings.impact: Marginally weaker defense-in-depth against local malware. Origin is loopback-only.
findings.root_cause: CORP was deliberately omitted from origin middleware because Worker adds it
findings.recommendation: Add CORP as defense-in-depth even though Worker provides it

findings.evidence: Key named 'switch_to_chinese' but the label shows 'English' when in Chinese mode
findings.trigger: Code review confusion — key name does not match behavior
findings.root_cause: Key named after one direction of the toggle, not the label itself

residual_risks: VPC Service Binding requires WARP or cloudflared private network routing on the origin
Cloudflare Worker was not redeployed after commit b884d33 (edge-rate-limiting capability missing)
Node.js not available — Worker deployment blocked locally
CSP unsafe-inline + unsafe-eval is a NiceGUI 3.13 framework constraint
roster_core package has import error when loaded standalone (roster_policy not installed as editable package)
Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy on Worker may affect popup-based flows
No concurrency stress tests (multi-user, multi-tab, cross-mode) were exercised during this audit
strengths_preserved: Strong HMAC-based session validation on both origin (gateway_identity.py) and Worker (worker.js)
Consistent html_safety.py attr()/text() escaping across all UI components
Multi-layer transaction design (maintenance lock -> serialized_operation -> BEGIN IMMEDIATE -> commit/rollback)
Idempotency pattern with command receipts and replay protection
Fail-closed Cloudflare Access authentication without forwarding credentials to origin
ORM-exclusive data operations — no raw SQL injection surface
Defense-in-depth security headers at both Worker edge and origin middleware
